# Canadian Forest Growth & Yield Model Registry

A registry of forest growth and yield models developed for
or applicable to Canadian forests.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(knitr)

models <- read_csv(
  "derived/models_web.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

models |>
  select(
    model_name,
    developer_organization,
    model_type,
    status
  ) |>
  kable()
```
